prompt:

Answer "supported" only if the sentences state that Ramp Control Lead produces or sends this item AND that Capacity Assessment Module receives or uses the same item (it may be named more briefly in one sentence). Return JSON {"verdict": ..., "reason": "one sentence"}.
response: {"verdict":"uncertain","reason":"S584 shows the Capacity Assessment Module uses persistent apron congestion, but S218 has the Ramp Control Lead escalating apron congestion only to the Tower Supervisor and Airport Duty Manager, so no sentence links the Ramp Control Lead as the source of the module's input."}
